requiredFindings.finding: Step 7 tests the merged winner map rather than CompiledDefaultsV1. If defaults.capabilities is None but the project supplies a valid capabilities array, or defaults.budget_limit is None but global/project supplies a valid budget, resolution succeeds. AQ:132-137 requires missing compiled capabilities/budget to be CONFIG_DEFAULTS_INCOMPLETE, not a configuration spelling repaired by another layer. The current tests remove each field only when no higher layer supplies it.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Check completeness of the original compiled-defaults input at step 7, independently of the merged winners, preserving the eleven-step order and the existing host-invariant route. Add controls for missing compiled capabilities and budget masked by valid external overrides, while preserving lawful overrides of complete defaults.

requiredFindings.finding: Cross-field duplicate/conflict detection scans pins before holds and always attributes the refusal to the holds winner on the second appearance. With valid defaults.holds=[A@1] and an external project components.pins=[A@2], the project introduces the conflict, but the code calls refuse(Layer::Defaults, ...) and returns HostInvariant/exit 4 instead of CONFIG.INVALID/exit 2. The symmetric project-holds/default-pins case is external, so equivalent external defects get different public rows based on field traversal order. Existing cross-layer tests use only two external layers.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Retain provenance for both conflicting values and attribute externally introduced cross-layer conflicts to the external input, with a deterministic subject policy. Reserve host-invariant faults for conflicts already present wholly in host-built inputs. Add default-holds/project-pins and default-pins/project-holds tests for duplicate and conflicting versions, retaining the existing closed codes.
